notes: Counts match the parts list: 366 pieces (the sticker sheet is b366).

Build order: well car A (b1-b82), well car B (b83-b164), two end bogies (b165-b180), the shared centre bogie (b181-b202), grey container (b203-b260), blue (b261-b295), red (b296-b330), white (b331-b365).

Connectivity: the booklet sets the grey container into car A's well and the white container into car B's well. To keep the build one connected model, the grey container's base plates (b203, b204) now rest on the car's studded end plates (b55, b56), not on tiles. The white container's base (b331) rests on the car's studded black 1x2 plates (b135, b136). Red sits on grey and blue on white. The sticker sheet is joined to a car panel and a container, because stickers go on both.

rests_on is read as 'already-placed pieces this piece's bottom clutches'. Some sub-assemblies are drawn upside down (container feet, deck end plates), so those pieces list the plate they attach to instead of what is physically underneath in the finished model.
Which piece clutches which is partly inferred from the small booklet drawings. The side rails, wall panels, bogie plate stacks and the end-deck sandwiches are best estimates.
Wheel holder 2878c01 is a complete assembly; its wheels are not separate pieces. Each end bogie and the centre bogie uses two.
The 2x4 black Technic plates (lego-3709) and the 2x2 round plates with axle hole (4032a) are used where the booklet shows plates with holes.

Container end blocks (1x4 brick, handle bricks and grille brick, 1x4 brick, tile) sit on the end studs of the base plate. The corner plates on the underside are the 'feet'. The red container's feet clutch the grey container's top 2x6 plates; the blue container's feet clutch the white container's top 2x6 plate.
Stickers are not attached to specific positions.
